info.description:
Backend API of Sonata.

**Auth.** `POST /api/auth/login` returns an access token (30 min), a refresh token (7 days) and the user's `routes`. Send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. On 401, call `POST /api/auth/refresh` with `Authorization: Bearer <refreshToken>` once, then log in again.

**Routes.** Access is granted per path group, e.g. `{"path": "/api/payments/**", "read": true, "write": false}`. GET needs `read`; POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE need `write`. Each operation below says which route it needs. A missing flag gives 403. Role changes reach the token at the next refresh; `GET /api/users/me` shows them at once.

**Request and session ids.** Every response has `X-Request-Id`; show it in error messages. Send `X-Session-Id` (one id per browser tab) so a tab's requests can be traced together.

**Errors.** Every documented error uses the `ApiError` body. Some older endpoints still answer 404/400 with an empty body.
